title: 第15章规划路线第16章祝由术谢谢投月票的诸位比心
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
既然师父叫了，许峰上前，还顺道给师父喂了两口水。
背拉着这鸡公车，师父感慨：“最近这世道，越来越不太平了！”
随后转移话题说道：“对了，你和你刘叔家的两个小娃娃处的怎么样？”
许峰：“还好，两个小娃娃挺可爱的。”
师父：“那只狗呢？”
许峰：“好威风的一只狗，师父，那一只狗怕是能把人嚼碎吃了，凶狠的很！”
师父：“那是当然，这是你刘叔的不传之秘，刽子手的食鬼奴！
可以识人心，怖邪鬼的。
要不是它，你刘叔也不会放心叫自家的两个娃子在院子里面耍！
这拍花子的人，可不管你在家不在家，看到娃娃，只会抓走、哄走。”
许峰：“现今拍花子的人张狂到这样地步了么？”
师父：“张狂？这有甚张狂的？比这张狂的还有哩！”
略微沉默了一会，许峰再度给师父喂水，换个话题问道：“师父，这背后的瓶子是什么东西？”
赵二说道：“这些都是魂瓶，要压在土地庙下面的。”
许峰：“魂瓶？”
赵二说道：“是哩，魂瓶。”
见师父没有解释的意思，许峰再换了一个话题，问道：“那师父，这些铁锹是做什么用的？”
师父闻言，这一次他回头看了一眼，眼神之中活泛起来，盯着许峰说道：“给你松活筋骨的。”
这一次，换做许峰不回答了。
赵二奇道：“怎么这一回，你不问我为什么给你松活筋骨了？我看你也不是一个不喜欢问问题的人。

怎么，不想松活筋骨？”
许峰不慌不忙：“师父这样做，自然有这样做的道理，我听明白了，就跟着师父做。师父总不会害我。”
闻言，赵二笑了起来：“不错，知道师父不会害你就好了。”
他左右看了一眼，对着许峰神神秘秘地说道：“你不是想要学习制衡鬼神的手段么？师父回去就教你这手段，不过想要学了手段，还是要从根本说起。
师父这不是就在教你根本么！”
没有更多解释，二人在天黑之前赶到了社庙，一进入社庙之中，就连师父都松了一口气。
二人给社庙的土地老爷上香，随后，师父从怀里掏出来了一个荷叶包，打开之后，里头是些香卤肉。
他叫许峰就馍吃了，他还有事情要做。
将那布匹包裹的短刀放在身边，他在偏房之中，铺展了黄表纸，琢磨了一会儿之后，开始奋笔疾书了。
许峰若有所思。他不知道刽子手刘叔和师父说了些甚么，但是明显可以感觉得到，师父此刻好像是多了些急迫的情绪。
不过，许峰也看得出来，这种情绪，自己去问也问不出来甚么。
他现在尚且不足以成为师父依仗。
不但不是依仗，他也不得做师父的“商量人”。
也就是说，师父身边连一个商量的人都没有，他作为弟子，甚至于可能还是个累赘。
故而吃了些东西之后，许峰拿起来了香谱，开始学习。
没有比这个更加重要的事情了。
在这香谱之中，小凶占了其中一章，师父说的和书上写的殊无二致——毕竟都是出自一人之手，但是许峰在开始阅读的时候，却想起来了自己在祝由术和医书上看到的那些只言片语。
content_en:
Now that the master had called, Xu Feng stepped forward and fed the master two sips of water.
Pulling this chicken bus on his back, Master sighed: "Recently, the world has become less and less peaceful!"
Then he changed the subject and said, "By the way, how are you getting along with your two little kids from Uncle Liu's family?"
Xu Feng: "Fortunately, the two little dolls are quite cute."
Master: "Where is the dog?"
Xu Feng: "What a majestic dog, Master. That dog can chew up people and eat them. It's so vicious!"
Master: "Of course, this is your Uncle Liu's secret, the executioner's ghost-eating slave!
He can understand the human heart and be afraid of evil spirits.
If it weren't for it, your Uncle Liu wouldn't be able to let his two children play in the yard without worry!
This person who takes pictures of flowers doesn't care whether you are at home or not. When he sees the doll, he will just grab it and coax it away. "
Xu Feng: "Are today's flower photographers so arrogant?"
Master: "Arrogant? How can this be arrogant? There are many more arrogant than this!"
After a moment of silence, Xu Feng gave Master water again, changed the subject and asked, "Master, what is the bottle behind this?"
Zhao Er said: "These are soul bottles, which should be placed under the Earth Temple."
Xu Feng: "Soul bottle?"
Zhao Er said: "Yes, soul bottle."
Seeing that Master had no intention of explaining, Xu Feng changed the topic and asked, "Master, what are these shovels used for?"
When the master heard this, he looked back this time, his eyes became lively, he stared at Xu Feng and said, "I'll loosen up your muscles and bones."
This time, Xu Feng did not answer.
Zhao Erqi said: "Why don't you ask me why I relaxed your muscles this time? I don't think you are a person who doesn't like to ask questions.
What, you don’t want to loosen your muscles? "
Xu Feng calmly said: "Master does this, of course there is a reason for doing so. I understand and follow Master. Master will never harm me."
Hearing this, Zhao Er laughed: "Yes, it's good to know that Master will not harm you."
He glanced left and right and said mysteriously to Xu Feng: "Don't you want to learn the means to check and balance ghosts and gods? Master will teach you this method when you get back, but if you want to learn the means, you still have to start from the fundamentals.
Master, isn’t this just teaching you the fundamentals! "
Without any further explanation, the two of them arrived at the temple before dark. As soon as they entered the temple, even the master breathed a sigh of relief.
The two of them offered incense to the land master of the temple. Then, the master took out a lotus leaf bag from his arms. After opening it, there was some fragrant braised pork inside.
He asked Xu Feng to eat steamed buns, as he still had things to do.
Putting the short knife wrapped in cloth next to him, he spread out the yellow paper in the side room. After pondering for a while, he began to write quickly.
Xu Feng was thoughtful. He didn't know what the executioner Uncle Liu said to his master, but he could clearly feel that his master seemed to be more anxious at the moment.
However, Xu Feng could also see that even if he asked about this kind of emotion, he wouldn't be able to figure out anything.
He is not yet strong enough to be the master to rely on.
Not only was he not to be relied upon, he was also not allowed to be the master's "consultant."
In other words, there is not even a person around the master who can discuss things. As a disciple, he may even be a burden.
So after eating something, Xu Feng picked up the incense book and started studying.
Nothing is more important than this.
In this incense manual, Xiao Ji occupies one chapter. What the master said was exactly the same as what was written in the book - after all, they were all written by one person. However, when Xu Feng started reading, he remembered those fragments of words he had seen in Zhu Youshu and medical books.
